svg.text: Minute Details That Change Exoplanet Inference
Why Hubble, Euclid, and Roman must be combined carefully for bulge exoplanet science
Many binaries stay unresolved at 800 AU
Euclid VIS helps; NISP 0.33" blends more
Blends bias radii, ages, SEDs, source flux
Bulge dust dims blue light more
Roman F146 gathers photons through dust
Euclid VIS adds optical color; NISP YJH
SED fits need passbands + dust laws
GBTDS cadence resolves planets and transits
Miss any one of these three and planet radii / masses can shift systematically
